lyrics.original: 한 번 싸우면 이틀은 가니까
lyrics.romanization: han beon ssau myeon iteureun ganikka
lyrics.english: One fight, Lasts for two days

lyrics.original: 딱 세 번만 참으려 했는데
lyrics.romanization: ttak se beonman cham euryeo haenneunde
lyrics.english: So I tried to hold back just three times

lyrics.romanization: ikkat sarangi mwonji daseot beoneun deo chamgo inneun naega jinjja hoguinga sipda

lyrics.original: 또 뭐가 왜? 네 눈칫밥에
